notes.subject: karvim
notes.rationale: עצב is properly 'to carve, fashion' — the potter's verb; 'karvim' keeps the craftsman picture.

notes.subject: וְאֵין ... וּמַצִּיל
notes.rationale: Verse 8 continues v.7's imagery: hands that shaped him now swallow him — form and unform by the same hands, echoing Gen 2:7 potter language.

notes.subject: ותבלעני
notes.rationale: 'You swallow me up' — some render as question ('would you destroy me?') matching v.9's dust; kept as statement of the swallowing.

translation: Ol han bilong yu i karvim ⟨את⟩ mi na ol i mekim ⟨את⟩ mi, wantaim olgeta, raunraun; na yu swarapim ⟨את⟩ mi gen.
